snippet.title: Dartmouth Championship Football (1965) | The Early History of Video Games | Part 7.2
snippet.description:
Dartmouth Championship Football is another of John Kemeny's initial BASIC games from 1965. This is far more of a game than the previous baseball game. You have the choice of several offensive plays, although the outcomes are entirely randomised. Several other events can occur during the course of the game, including play being interrupted by a dog running onto the field.

This game and many other early text-based games can be downloaded and played through Vintage BASIC: http://vintage-basic.net/index.html

Want to learn more? Read about it here: https://obsessivegamingchronology.blogspot.com/2024/07/prehistory-vii-sports-sports-sports-and.html
